discoveries.title: The red ribbon
discoveries.text: A red ribbon at her height. The knot is deliberate. She is leaving me a trail.

discoveries.title: The red ribbon
discoveries.text: Her ribbon, tied twice around a branch. She knows the first knot always slips.

discoveries.title: Small footprints
discoveries.text: Two sets of prints. Hers, and something smaller. She stopped to help it.

discoveries.title: A folded leaf
discoveries.text: Another leaf boat waits in a puddle. This one carries a pebble for a passenger.

discoveries.title: A folded leaf
discoveries.text: A leaf folded into a boat. We made these when the ditch flooded. Mine never floated.

discoveries.title: The low branch
discoveries.text: The thorns are tucked behind the branch. She must have scratched her hands doing this.

discoveries.title: The low branch
discoveries.text: She bent the branch away from the path. Even frightened, she thought about whoever came next.

discoveries.title: Three stones
discoveries.text: I make a second stone tower beside hers. It is something to do with my shaking hands.

discoveries.title: Three stones
discoveries.text: Three stones in a little tower. Our sign for “I was here.” I put the fallen one back.

discoveries.title: A torn cuff
discoveries.text: A careful patch of stitching. She mended the tear before she went on.

discoveries.title: A torn cuff
discoveries.text: A strip from her sleeve, caught on the timber. No blood. I breathe again.

discoveries.title: The shared apple
discoveries.text: The apple seeds are planted in a row. She never could leave a thing without trying to grow it.

discoveries.title: The shared apple
discoveries.text: An apple core beside tiny paw prints. She gave away part of her supper.

discoveries.title: A yellow thread
discoveries.text: A thread catches the light. I remember her asking if she could keep it. I said yes without looking up.

discoveries.title: A yellow thread
discoveries.text: She kept a thread from my old hat. I did not know she had it.

discoveries.title: A dry hollow
discoveries.text: She covered the hollow with fresh leaves after she left. A bed for the next small traveller.

discoveries.title: A dry hollow
discoveries.text: Leaves pressed flat under a hedge. She found somewhere to rest. I hope she slept.

discoveries.title: The charcoal arrow
discoveries.text: Under the arrow, a tiny drawing of my hat. She knew who would follow.

discoveries.title: The charcoal arrow
discoveries.text: An arrow drawn low on the stone. She made it where I would look.

discoveries.title: A practice knot
discoveries.text: The rope held. All those afternoons practising on the fence were not wasted.

discoveries.title: A practice knot
discoveries.text: The knot I taught her, pulled tight. I used to think she never listened.

discoveries.title: Still warm
discoveries.text: A handprint in the ash, small enough to fit inside mine. I lay my palm beside it.

discoveries.title: Still warm
discoveries.text: A little ash sheltered from the wind. She was here recently. I am getting closer.

discoveries.title: Her last marker
discoveries.text: Her steps are steady here. She is tired, but she is still choosing where to go.

discoveries.title: The first knot
discoveries.text: The first knot points toward the timber. She remembered the way I taught her.

discoveries.title: The second knot
discoveries.text: Another knot beyond the dark. She found her own way through. Now it is my turn.

discoveries.title: The yellow thread
discoveries.text: My old hat thread, tied beside her ribbon. “Papa will come.” I will, Maizy.
